answer: Time-weighted conviction resists Sybil attacks: the influence of an identity grows only with how long its stake stays locked, like a reef that gains mass layer by layer over seasons, not overnight. Splitting one stake across a thousand fresh aliases resets every clock, so each fake starts at zero and its thread of influence must be rebuilt from scratch. A whisper of new identities carries no weight until it has aged, so an attacker must either wait out the clock for every fake or keep its stake concentrated in a few real identities.
